# Infantry AI

> Infantry AI is a command post for coding agents: a daemon with a ticket board, agents on their own git branches, mail, shared project knowledge, Lua scripts and hooks, plus a desktop app (Tauri 2 with a React front end), an Android app and the `infantry` CLI. It runs on BattalionOS, the MPL-2.0 core and shell; the daemon is a Rust binary and features are plugins (a module with a `module.json` and a WASM or sidecar daemon half). Everything on top of the core is Apache-2.0.

Read AGENTS.md first. Facts in these docs come from the code; where a page and the code disagree, the code wins.
